works.title: Project 2030
works.description: A counter-manifesto to the Heritage Foundation's Project 2025, reversing its policy positions while framing the alternative as a utopian corrective grounded in values articulated by historical moral figures (Christ, Buddha, MLK). Planned as a rapid AI-assisted creation.
works.quote: With AI assistance, would it only take a couple of hours to completely reverse that and make a project 2030 that basically does the opposite of 2025 in every way?
